title: [Eurycomanone inhibits renal ischemia/reperfusion-induced mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammation in mice by binding to STAT3 to inhibit its phosphorylation].
authors: Liu, Ze; Mao, Zhangkun; You, Da; Wang, Junjie; He, Yongmei; Yu, Yiwen; Wen, Zhiqiang; Fang, Huilong; He, Wenxia
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Eurycomanone通过结合STAT3抑制其磷酸化来缓解肾缺血再灌注损伤，虽涉及蛋白-小分子结合与分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the mechanism of eurycomanone (EN) for ameliorating ischemia/reperfusion (IR)-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) in mice. METHODS: Twenty-four male C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into 4 groups (n=6) for sham operation, IR modeling by bilateral renal pedicle clamping, or intraperitoneal injections of EN at 0.25 or 1.0 mg/kg for two days prior to surgery. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to identify the potential molecular targets and signaling pathways and evaluate the binding affinities. Renal function, histopathological changes, expression of tubular injury markers (KIM-1 and NGAL), phosphorylation levels of STAT3, PI3K, and JAK2, renal inflammation, mitochondrial biogenesis, and mitochondrial function of the mice were assessed. The interaction between EN and STAT3 was examined using surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Another 24 male C57BL/6J mice receiving sham operation, IR modeling, or EN or EN+ML115 (a STAT3 agonist) treatment prior to modeling (n=6) were used to validate the role of STAT3 in EN-mediated renal protection. RESULTS: Both low- and high-dose EN significantly alleviated renal injury and improved renal function in mice with IR-induced AKI. The core targets of EN were associated with inflammation-related signaling pathways. EN treatment markedly reduced renal levels of IL-6, MCP-1, and TNF-alphaand decreased macrophage infiltration (F4/80-positive cells) in renal interstitial tissue of the mice. EN also significantly increased renal ATP content and mitochondrial DNA copy number (P<0.05), and upregulated the expressions of PGC-1alpha, TFAM, and Nrf2 mRNAs and protein levels of PGC-1alpha and TOM20. Molecular docking identified STAT3 and PI3K as key molecular targets of EN. In mice with IR-induced AKI, EN significantly suppressed phosphorylation of STAT3 and PI3K in the renal tissues without affecting p-JAK2 levels. SPR analysis confirmed a direct and specific interaction between EN and STAT3. Notably, activation of STAT3 by ML115 significantly reversed the renoprotective effects of EN. CONCLUSIONS: EN mitigates IR-induced AKI in mice by directly binding to STAT3 to inhibit its phosphorylation, suppressing inflammation, and enhancing mitochondrial biogenesis and function, suggesting the potential of EN as a promising therapeutic candidate for IR-induced AKI.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨宽缨酮（eurycomanone, EN）改善小鼠缺血/再灌注（ischemia/reperfusion, IR）诱导的急性肾损伤（acute kidney injury, AKI）的机制。方法：将24只雄性C57BL/6J小鼠随机分为4组（n=6），分别进行假手术、双侧肾蒂夹闭建立IR模型，或在术前两天腹腔注射EN（0.25或1.0 mg/kg）。采用网络药理学和分子对接技术识别潜在分子靶点及信号通路，并评估结合亲和力。评估小鼠的肾功能、组织病理学变化、肾小管损伤标志物（KIM-1和NGAL）表达、STAT3、PI3K和JAK2的磷酸化水平、肾脏炎症、线粒体生物发生及线粒体功能。使用表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）检测EN与STAT3之间的相互作用。另取24只雄性C57BL/6J小鼠，接受假手术、IR建模，或在建模前给予EN或EN+ML115（一种STAT3激动剂）处理（n=6），以验证STAT3在EN介导的肾脏保护中的作用。结果：低剂量和高剂量EN均显著减轻了IR诱导的AKI小鼠的肾损伤并改善了肾功能。EN的核心靶点与炎症相关信号通路有关。EN处理显著降低了小鼠肾脏中IL-6、MCP-1和TNF-α的水平，并减少了肾间质组织中巨噬细胞浸润（F4/80阳性细胞）。EN还显著增加了肾脏ATP含量和线粒体DNA拷贝数（P<0.05），并上调了PGC-1α、TFAM和Nrf2 mRNA的表达以及PGC-1α和TOM20的蛋白水平。分子对接确定STAT3和PI3K为EN的关键分子靶点。在IR诱导的AKI小鼠中，EN显著抑制了肾组织中STAT3和PI3K的磷酸化，而不影响p-JAK2水平。SPR分析证实了EN与STAT3之间存在直接且特异的相互作用。值得注意的是，ML115激活STAT3显著逆转了EN的肾脏保护作用。结论：EN通过直接结合STAT3抑制其磷酸化、抑制炎症并增强线粒体生物发生和功能，从而减轻IR诱导的小鼠AKI，提示EN可能成为IR诱导AKI的有前景的治疗候选药物。
